toolkit_connection_statuses.description: Stripe offers online payment infrastructure, fraud prevention, and APIs enabling businesses to accept and manage payments globally

STRIPE_CREATE_TAX_REGISTRATION.description: Creates a new Tax Registration object to enable tax collection in specified jurisdictions. Use when setting up tax collection for a new country, state, or province.

country.description: Two-letter ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code where tax collection will be enabled (e.g., 'US', 'CA', 'GB', 'DE').

expires_at.description: Optional Unix timestamp in seconds when the registration becomes inactive. Omit for indefinite validity.

active_from.description: Activation time for the registration. Use 'now' for immediate activation or provide a future Unix timestamp in seconds for scheduled activation.

country_options.description: Country-specific configuration object. The key must match the country code. Value contains type-specific configuration (e.g., for US: includes 'state' and 'type'; for EU: includes 'type' and 'standard' config when type='standard'; for CA: includes 'type' and optional nested configs).

anyOf.title: UsCountryOptions

type.title: Type
type.description: Type of US tax registration. Common types include 'state_sales_tax', 'state_communications_tax', 'local_amusement_tax', 'local_lease_tax', or 'state_retail_delivery_fee'.

anyOf.title: UsCountryOptionsStateSalesTax

items.title: UsCountryOptionsStateElection

type.title: Type
type.description: Type of election. Must be 'local_use_tax' or 'simplified_sellers_use_tax'.

jurisdiction.title: Jurisdiction
jurisdiction.description: FIPS code for the jurisdiction (e.g., local county or city code).

items.description: Election options for US state sales tax with multi-jurisdictional rules.

elections.title: Elections
elections.description: Array of election objects for multi-jurisdictional sales tax rules within the state.

anyOf.description: State sales tax specific configuration for US registrations.

state_sales_tax.description: Configuration for state sales tax, including multi-jurisdictional elections if applicable.

anyOf.description: Country-specific options for United States tax registrations.

anyOf.title: EuCountryOptions

type.title: Type
type.description: Type of EU tax registration. Must be 'standard', 'ioss' (Import One-Stop Shop), 'oss_union' (One-Stop Shop for EU), or 'oss_non_union' (One-Stop Shop for non-EU).

anyOf.title: StandardOptions

place_of_supply_scheme.title: Place Of Supply Scheme
place_of_supply_scheme.description: Tax collection scheme. 'standard' applies tax to domestic sales only, 'inbound_goods' collects tax at destination for imported goods, 'small_seller' allows seller's rate across EU.

anyOf.description: Standard registration options applicable to most countries.

standard.description: Standard registration configuration. REQUIRED when type is 'standard'. If not provided when type='standard', defaults to StandardOptions(place_of_supply_scheme='standard').

anyOf.description: Country-specific options for EU tax registrations.

anyOf.title: CaCountryOptions

type.title: Type
type.description: Type of Canadian tax registration. Must be 'standard', 'simplified', or 'province_standard'.

anyOf.title: CaProvinceStandardOptions
anyOf.description: Province standard configuration for Canadian tax registrations.

province_standard.description: Province-specific configuration required when type is 'province_standard'.

anyOf.description: Country-specific options for Canadian tax registrations.

STRIPE_GET_TAX_SETTINGS.description: Retrieves Tax Settings for a merchant. Use when you need to fetch the tax configuration for a Stripe account.

expand.description: Specifies which fields in the response should be expanded. Supports dot notation for nested expansion (e.g., 'data.customer'). Maximum depth of four levels for expansions.

STRIPE_LIST_TAX_REGISTRATIONS.description: Retrieves a paginated list of tax registrations. Use when you need to view where a business is registered to collect tax on payments within various regions.

limit.description: Number of objects to return per request. Range: 1-100. Defaults to 10 if not specified.

status.description: Filter registrations by their current status. Defaults to 'all' if not specified.

ending_before.description: Cursor for backward pagination. Object ID to fetch results before this object, used to retrieve previous pages.

starting_after.description: Cursor for forward pagination. Object ID to fetch results after this object, used to retrieve subsequent pages.
